name: word_limit
description: Check that a piece of text is inside a word budget. Exits non-zero when it is over, with the count and the overage on stderr.

text.description: The text to measure. Counted as whitespace-separated words, exactly as given.

max_words.description: The most words the text may contain. Written in the flow rather than templated: a rendered template is a string, and this has to be a number.

output_schema.description: The count and the limit, with no trailing newline.

exit_codes.0: inside the limit (the count is on stdout)
exit_codes.1: over the limit (the count, the overage and the limit are on stderr)
exit_codes.2: invalid input (stdin was not a JSON object, or a parameter is missing or the wrong type)
